description: Core implementation of FSUI handling logic, including parsing and evaluating reverse Polish notation expressions, operator registration, and table management.

classes.name: LENameOrdinalPair
classes.description: Represents a pair of operator/method name and its associated action, used for registration and parsing.

classes.name: LEElement
classes.description: Represents an element (token) in the expression, including its action type and value.

classes.name: LECalculator
classes.description: Handles parsing, evaluation, and stack management for logical expressions in reverse Polish notation.

classes.name: LEElementPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of LEElement objects for efficient expression parsing.

methods.name: LENameOrdinalPair::LENameOrdinalPair
methods.description: Constructor that registers the operator/method name with its action.

methods.name: LEElement::clear
methods.description: Resets the element to default state.

methods.name: LEElement::init
methods.description: Initializes the element with an action and optional value.

methods.name: LECalculator::reset
methods.description: Resets the calculator state and logs.

methods.name: LECalculator::add
methods.description: Adds an element to the expression list.

methods.name: LECalculator::pop
methods.description: Pops a value from the stack with error checking.

methods.name: LECalculator::push
methods.description: Pushes a value onto the stack and logs the action.

methods.name: LECalculator::processElement
methods.description: Processes a single element, performing the corresponding operation.

methods.name: LECalculator::getValue
methods.description: Evaluates the entire expression and returns the result.

methods.name: LEElementPool::next
methods.description: Retrieves the next available LEElement from the pool.

methods.name: LEElementPool::parseExpression
methods.description: Parses a string expression into a linked list of LEElements.
